nodes.name: objectives_to_workflows_matrix.md
nodes.summary: Methodology-pack reference that maps Trendzo product objectives to the concrete workflows, screens, and services that deliver them, used as the canonical traceability matrix between strategy and implementation.

nodes.name: generation_analysis_prediction.md
nodes.summary: Methodology spec for the template system covering generation, analysis, and viral-prediction stages, including the engine inputs, scoring outputs, and integration points with the prediction pipeline.

nodes.name: telemetry_events.md
nodes.summary: Canonical catalog of telemetry events emitted by the template system, defining event names, payload schemas, and the consumers that depend on them for analytics and feedback loops.

nodes.name: template_contract.md
nodes.summary: Defines the canonical template schema and contract that producers and consumers across the platform must honour, including required fields, versioning rules, and validation expectations.

nodes.name: variants_and_surfaces.md
nodes.summary: Specifies template variant architecture and the UI surfaces (creator workflow, admin lab, recipe book) where each variant renders, including selection rules and surface-specific constraints.

nodes.name: external_integrations.md
nodes.summary: Catalog of external integrations used by Trendzo (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Apify, Gemini, OpenAI, etc.), enumerating endpoints, auth flows, quotas, and the internal services that consume each.

nodes.name: internal_services.md
nodes.summary: Internal service API catalog covering authentication, prediction, training, content-intelligence, and observability services with their boundaries, contracts, and call graphs.

nodes.name: sample_rows.json
nodes.summary: Representative sample rows for core Trendzo database entities (users, templates, predictions, etc.) used as fixture data for docs, tests, and onboarding examples.

nodes.name: entities_and_fields.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive database schema reference for Trendzo entities and their fields, capturing relationships, types, and the canonical naming used across Supabase migrations and TypeScript models.

nodes.name: storage_policies_security.md
nodes.summary: Documents data classification, Supabase RLS policies, encryption, retention, and access-control rules that govern Trendzo storage, treated as the security baseline for the methodology pack.

nodes.name: component_testids.md
nodes.summary: Complete reference of data-testid attributes for UI components across admin, creator, and recipe-book surfaces, used as the contract between component implementations and end-to-end tests.

nodes.name: test_plan.md
nodes.summary: Quality assurance strategy and test plan including testing philosophy, pyramid structure, performance targets, and security testing scope for the Trendzo platform.

nodes.name: 00_glossary.md
nodes.summary: Glossary of core Trendzo concepts (VPS, DPS, packs, cohorts, niches, templates) that anchors terminology across the methodology pack and product documentation.

nodes.name: 09_open_questions_risks.md
nodes.summary: Tracks open product and engineering questions plus an assessment of strategic and technical risks for Trendzo, used as the living risk register in the methodology pack.

nodes.name: 10_decisions_next_steps.md
nodes.summary: Locked architectural decisions and the next-step roadmap distilled from the methodology pack, including executive summary, decision log, and prioritized follow-up actions.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Entry-point readme for the Trendzo Methodology Pack v1.0 that summarizes scope, navigation across the 00-10 sections, and how the pack is used by product and engineering teams.

nodes.name: COMPLETE-MONITORING-SYSTEM.md
nodes.summary: End-to-end design of the BMAD monitoring and alerting system, covering metrics, dashboards, alert routing, and runbooks used to observe the Trendzo prediction stack.

nodes.name: ryos-behavior-mirroring.md
nodes.summary: Policy statement defining how Trendzo mirrors ryOS-style UI behavior in an AGPL-safe manner, including allowed inspirations and prohibited copying of code or assets.

nodes.name: admin-prediction-lab-prd-v1.md
nodes.summary: Product requirements document v1.0 for the Admin Prediction Lab covering executive summary, user stories, functional requirements, and success metrics for the internal admin tooling.

nodes.name: FEAT-071-unified-creator-workflow.md
nodes.summary: Full PRD for FEAT-071 unifying the creator workflow into a 6-step system, including objectives, surfaces, data contracts, telemetry, and rollout plan; the largest spec in the methodology corpus.

nodes.name: phase-0-implementation-plan.md
nodes.summary: Phase 0 implementation plan for the Admin Prediction Lab containing pre-flight checklist, research findings, task breakdown, and acceptance criteria used as the engineering execution doc.

nodes.summary: Reference configuration capturing ryOS-inspired layout, keyboard, and motion behavior tokens that Trendzo UI components consult to maintain parity without copying source.

nodes.name: ryos-parity.md
nodes.summary: Behavior-only parity reference describing which ryOS interaction patterns Trendzo replicates and how, paired with the ryos-reference.json token file.

nodes.name: viral-recipe-book.contract-diff.md
nodes.summary: Contract diff report for the Viral Recipe Book feature, listing schema and API changes versus the prior contract along with affected features and consumers.

nodes.summary: Completion report for the Viral Recipe Book feature summarizing what shipped and a 5-step demo script for stakeholders to verify the delivered behavior.
